source.mechanism: Permanent FORM mutations grant native cached traits through enchantments. These are not removable doses or a second story line.

COUNT_PAWN.en: Your slippery skin helps you escape grabs, especially where it is uncovered.
COUNT_PAWN.ru: Скользкая кожа помогает вырываться из захватов, особенно на открытых участках тела.

COUNT_FLESH.en: Slippery skin helps you escape grabs. Gills let you breathe underwater.
COUNT_FLESH.ru: Скользкая кожа помогает вырываться из захватов. Жабры позволяют дышать под водой.

WYALD_PAWN.en: Padded feet need no shoes and soften your footsteps. Uncovered claws serve as natural weapons.
WYALD_PAWN.ru: Мягкие стопы позволяют обходиться без обуви и приглушают шаги. Открытые когти служат естественным оружием.

WYALD_FLESH.en: Padded feet soften your steps. Claws and fangs provide natural attacks. Activate Burrowing in the mutation menu to dig through suitable dirt and rubble.
WYALD_FLESH.ru: Мягкие стопы приглушают шаги. Когти и клыки дают естественные атаки. Способность «Рытьё» в меню мутаций позволяет копать подходящий грунт и завалы.

ROSINE_PAWN.en: Antennae sense nearby creatures even behind obstacles. Toggle them in the mutation menu.
ROSINE_PAWN.ru: Усики чувствуют ближайших существ даже за препятствиями. Их можно включать и выключать в меню мутаций.

ROSINE_FLESH.en: Antennae sense nearby creatures. Examine a roof edge or another ledge and choose to glide: your wings carry you down through open air without falling damage. Native gliding requires a light load and usable arms; your load must not exceed half your carrying capacity. Winged dive remains a separate short combat maneuver.
ROSINE_FLESH.ru: Усики чувствуют ближайших существ. Осмотрите край крыши или другой уступ и выберите планирование: крылья позволяют спускаться через открытый воздух без урона от падения. Для штатного планирования нужны рабочие руки и груз не тяжелее половины вашей грузоподъёмности. Боевое пикирование остаётся отдельным коротким манёвром.

GRUNBELD_PAWN.en: Hooked feet help you cross obstacles and walk along the bottom underwater. You still need air.
GRUNBELD_PAWN.ru: Цепкие стопы помогают преодолевать препятствия и ходить по дну под водой. Воздух вам по-прежнему необходим.

GRUNBELD_FLESH.en: Hooked feet let you walk along the bottom underwater, but you still need air. Activate Roomy Shell in the mutation menu to shelter your head and limbs within the shell; leave that posture to move freely again. Your changed body remains.
GRUNBELD_FLESH.ru: Цепкие стопы позволяют ходить по дну под водой, но воздух всё ещё нужен. Включите «Вместительный панцирь» в меню мутаций, чтобы укрыть голову и конечности; выйдите из этого положения, чтобы снова свободно двигаться. Изменённое тело остаётся.

native_traits.description: You've grown a set of gills in your neck, allowing you to breathe underwater.  Slightly increases wet benefits.
You have claws on the ends of your fingers.  If you aren't wearing gloves, your unarmed attacks deal a minor amount of cutting damage.
native_traits.//: No Lupine, wolf claws aren't long or sharp enough.

native_traits.description: Your claws have grown tougher and slightly gnarled.
The bottoms of your feet are strongly padded.  You receive no movement penalty for not wearing shoes, and your steps are significantly quieter, as added tissue dampens the noise.

native_traits.//: Since bears and wolves cannot get incisiors, but still burrow.
native_traits.description: Your tough paws allow you to dig through dirt and rubble with ease.
You have a pair of antennae.  They allow you to detect the presence of monsters up to a few tiles away, even if you can't see or hear them, but prevent wearing headwear that is not made of fabric.
Your body is coated with a fine slime which makes uncovered skin harder to grab and protects from long-term effects of acid, though not short-term ones.  Greatly increases wet benefits.
Your protective shell has grown large enough to accommodate--if need be--your whole body.  Activate to pull your head and limbs into your shell, trading mobility and vision for warmth and shelter.
Your hook-shaped feet curl inward to grip the ground, allowing you to easily walk along the bottom when you're underwater.  They're also a bit quicker at climbing over obstacles, even on dry land.
Your teeth have grown into long, sharp fangs.  If your mouth is uncovered, you'll sometimes bite your enemies.
